description: This file implements a security hook class 'ResponsesIDSecurity' for managing response ID encryption, decryption, and access control within a FastAPI-based proxy server. It prevents users from viewing responses they are not authorized to see by encrypting response IDs and checking user permissions.

classes.name: ResponsesIDSecurity
classes.description: A class that manages response ID security by encrypting/decrypting response IDs and enforcing access control based on user roles and response ownership.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-processing hook to decrypt response IDs and verify user access before API call execution.

methods.name: check_user_access_to_response_id
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to a response based on user ID and team ID, raising HTTPException if access is forbidden.

methods.name: _is_encrypted_response_id
methods.description: Determines if a response ID is encrypted by checking its format and decrypting it.

methods.name: _decrypt_response_id
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted response ID to extract the original response ID, user ID, and team ID.

methods.name: _get_signing_key
methods.description: Retrieves the signing key used for encrypting/decrypting response IDs, from environment variables or a master key.

methods.name: _encrypt_response_id
methods.description: Encrypts a response ID within a response object, encoding user and team IDs.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Queues response IDs for batch processing after a successful API call.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Encrypts response IDs in streaming responses if applicable.
